Definition: properly, girls, i.e. the soprano or female voice, perhaps falsetto
BiblicalUsage: Once in the body of the text, when David brings the ark to Jerusalem and the Levites play psalteries on Alamoth, the high soprano voice, above the harps. The word also heads Psalm 46, where the sons of Korah sing a song upon Alamoth over the psalm that begins, God is our refuge and strength.
TheologicalSignificance: One musical direction in one verse carries no theology of its own; its weight is the scene, that the ark came home to singing, and the highest voices led it.
